correctness.rationale: The degree-edge inequality proves the sharp minimum four. The Fano incidence case analysis exhausts all possible point-line splits, rules out 2+2 by an explicit 8-cycle, and gives all fourteen disjoint independent five-blocks. Pairwise block intersections prove precisely fourteen complete five-cliques under jump exchanges and their independence proves no slide exchanges. Two separate dependency-free programs using incidence masks/union-find and LCF/DFS reproduce all counts and transitions.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the unique cubic girth-six cage and canonical incidence graph of the Fano plane. The exact optimum-state geometry of forest deletion is a structurally motivated refinement of the minimum feedback number, particularly relevant to the recognized distinction between minimum and nonminimum reconfiguration for cubic graphs. The intrinsic partition into 14 Fano-indexed five-cliques explains complete fragmentation under unrestricted one-vertex exchange and a still stronger freeze under edge-local relocation. This is an exact natural classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
